summary.en: Drone attacks on a Colombian military base in the north killed three soldiers and wounded eight, showing an escalation of direct violence. Armed men entered a house in Toro, Colombia and murdered three women, adding to civilian casualties. The conflict remains a low-intensity asymmetric war involving the government, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates and far-left guerrillas. The UCDP recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Droneangrep på en colombiansk militærbase i nord drepte tre soldater og såret åtte, og viser en opptrapping av direkte vold. Bevæpnede menn gikk inn i et hus i Toro, Colombia og drepte tre kvinner, noe som øker antallet sivile ofre. Konflikten er fortsatt en lavintensiv asymmetrisk krig som involverer regjeringen, paramilitære grupper, kriminelle syndikater og venstreorienterte geriljer. UCDP registrerte 225 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
